verdict.rationale: Brex docs confirm tailored multi-level approval flows based on amount, vendor, and role with automatic routing (brex-docs-11), plus policy rule engine (brex-docs-8) and an AI review agent that auto-approves low-risk items and escalates exceptions (brex-docs-16). However, no evidence describes explicit delegation of approver authority when someone is unavailable, or configurable escalation timers/backup approvers. Missing for 10: documented delegation-to-backup-approver mechanism, explicit escalation timeout/reassignment settings, and confirmation of a distinct 'budget owner' approval step in the chain.
